About Jared Gibbons
Which areas of Tsawwassen should I look at for houses?

The main pockets are Tsawwassen Central, English Bluff, Boundary Bay, Beach Grove, Cliff Drive, Pebble Hill and Tsawwassen Springs. Each has a different mix of lot sizes, age of homes and price points, so I match the area to your budget and commute.
What schools serve Tsawwassen?

Homes here are in Delta School District 37 (South Delta Secondary, Cliff Drive, Pebble Hill, English Bluff, Beach Grove elementaries). Catchments are set by address, so confirm the specific school with the district before you buy.
How is transit and commuting from Tsawwassen?
Options include South Delta Exchange buses to Bridgeport Canada Line, Hwy 17 to the BC Ferries terminal, and Hwy 99 to Vancouver.
What zoning rules affect houses in Tsawwassen?
Detached lots are mostly Delta RS-zones; Tsawwassen First Nation lands (Tsawwassen Commons/Shores) are leasehold under TFN rules, so check title type.
What should I check before buying a detached house in Tsawwassen?
Freehold title, no strata fees, and room for a suite or garden. I review documents with you before subjects are removed.
Are first-time buyer exemptions available in Tsawwassen?
Yes, qualifying buyers can use the BC First-Time Home Buyers' property transfer tax exemption and the federal FHSA. See my first-time buyer guide for current thresholds.
